name: Image Bleed
summary: Reach for it when a single image should fill the slide edge to edge, behind an optional title.
description: One image drawn full-bleed behind the slide, with an optional title that keeps the normal slide padding. A slide names its picture as its slide image (design.slideImage, the same source as its image) and the layout places it at position background. Use it for a photograph or illustration that carries a mood or a transition between sections.
